name: domain-pulse-monorepo
description: Domain-pulse: Chrome Extension Side Panel + API Gateway for Real-time Domain Health Audits

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @domain-pulse/shared build && pnpm --filter @domain-pulse/server build && pnpm --filter @domain-pulse/extension build
scripts.build:safari: pnpm build:extension && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app xcrun safari-web-extension-converter apps/extension/dist --project-location apps/safari --app-name DomainPulse --bundle-identifier im.carlosrivera.DomainPulse --macos-only --no-open --force && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app xcodebuild -project apps/safari/DomainPulse/DomainPulse.xcodeproj -scheme DomainPulse -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
